question: Point out the FALSE response in relation to the surgical treatment of thoracic aortic aneurysms:

options.opa: The replacement of the aneurysmal aorta with a graft is indicated when the diameter of the ascending aorta is greater than 4.5 cm.
options.opb: In patients diagnosed with Marfan's disease or bicuspid aortic valve, surgical treatment will be considered when the aorta is between 4 and 5 cm in diameter.
options.opc: It is considered necessary to intervene on the descending aneurysmal thoracic aorta if its diameter is greater than 6 cm.
options.opd: It is recommended to replace the aneurysmal aorta when, in a period of 1 year, an increase in the diameter of the aneurysm of more than 1 cm is observed.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Surgical treatment indicated when the diameter of the ascending aorta is greater than 4.5 cm -> TRUE CHAIN: Surgical treatment in Marfan's disease or bicuspid aortic valve considered when aorta is between 4 and 5 cm in diameter -> TRUE CHAIN: Intervention on descending aneurysmal thoracic aorta necessary if diameter is greater than 6 cm -> TRUE CHAIN: Replacement of aneurysmal aorta recommended if an increase in diameter of more than 1 cm in 1 year is observed -> FALSE, as this statement is not accurate in the context of thoracic aortic aneurysms. -> 95%
analysis: The false response in relation to the surgical treatment of thoracic aortic aneurysms is option d. It is not recommended to replace the aneurysmal aorta based solely on a 1 cm increase in diameter within a year.
